title: Standard Development
description: Standard TDD workflow with architecture checks

steps.name: Check Architectures
steps.prompt: Review the architecture diagrams in docs/architectures/ for relevant diagrams.

steps.name: Write Unit Tests
steps.prompt: Write failing unit tests for the feature before implementing.

steps.name: Implement Feature
steps.prompt: Implement the feature to make the tests pass.

steps.name: Run Linters
steps.prompt: Run linting, type checking, and fix any issues.

steps.name: Update Documentation
steps.prompt: Update relevant documentation and architecture diagrams based on the changes made.

title: Architecture Generation
description: Workflow for generating SysML and UML diagrams

steps.name: Analyze & Plan
steps.prompt: Analyze the request and the existing codebase. Determine the components, relationships, and structure needed for the diagram. Output a textual plan of the diagram nodes and edges.

steps.name: Generate XML
steps.prompt: Based on the plan and the task description, generate a valid Draw.io (mxGraphModel) XML file. Ensure it uses standard shapes. Save the content directly to the target .drawio file specified in the task title.
